summary.prose: Building s10 adds a deterministic link reader to markdown indexing and the storage, reads and status around it, then a mid-tier model pass on the summary lane whose proposals stay in their own table and are only used behind a measured switch. The store gains two tables and one migration; the indexer gains a link reader and a pre-commit target check; the daemon gains two summary-lane jobs, two requests and a status field shown in the CLI and both plugins; the analyzer attaches document links at read so caches never serve stale model links. The Story ends with a live measurement against the approved hand-checked set, an installed-daemon smoke and one full test sweep.

tasks.title: Markdown link reader in ArtifactParser
tasks.summary: Extend ArtifactParser.parse (src/indexer/parser/artifact.ts) to emit REFERENCES with evidence 'extracted': link destinations resolved against the document's directory (leading / = repository root), path mentions with a slash resolved against the repository root (./ ../ against the directory), bare file-name mentions as pending name-reference relations; skip fenced/indented code, URLs with a scheme, mailto, pure anchors; strip anchors and trailing punctuation; require a parser-handled file name; attribute to the containing retained section, the whole-file document, or the file entity (preamble, skipped sections); dedupe per (source, target); no self links.
acceptanceChecks: In docs/guide/a.md, 'b.md', 'docs/b.md' and '/docs/b.md' link destinations resolve to docs/guide/b.md, docs/guide/docs/b.md and docs/b.md; the mentions `docs/b.md` and `./b.md` to docs/b.md and docs/guide/b.md
A preamble link is attributed to the file entity; links in fenced code, http(s) and mailto are not read
A bare 'README.md' yields a pending name-reference relation with meta.nameRef and no awaitsId
The parser touches neither the file system nor a model

Guard Pass 2 and the SQL re-check in src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts to skip meta.docLink rows. On removal of a target file, re-read each markdown document holding a returned pending REFERENCES (s1's lookup by awaited id).

Removing a target re-reads the citing document and the repository reads complete again
Pass 2 and the SQL re-check leave doc-link rows untouched; the SQL by-name return leaves document links as plain rows

tasks.title: Mid-tier role, provider selection and failure classification
tasks.summary: Add { id: 'indexer.docRelations', criticality: 'peripheral', defaultTier: 'mid' } to src/config/role-taxonomy.ts; a selector that runs resolveRole('indexer.docRelations', cfg, repoPath), refuses any tier other than mid, requires a CLI family with a listed model, and builds the provider from that resolution (or checks the router's ResolvedProvider under a routing context), returning the validated model id; a classifier that treats every error thrown by the provider call as a provider failure (message chain kept) and only a wrong-shape returned value as DocRelationsOutputInvalid.
acceptanceChecks: An override to the cheap tier (per-repo or global) is refused with a reason naming the tier, with and without a routing context
A CLI family with no listed model is refused before any call
Codex error/turn.failed, Claude is_error, Vibe wrapped, CliExitError, CliStallError and ModelCallFailedError errors classify as provider failures

tasks.title: The doc-relations pass
tasks.summary: New src/indexer/doc-relations-pass.ts: starts only on graphComplete; selects documents whose hash or validated model differs; one model call at a time through the t4 provider; validates each returned value; drops proposals with unknown source or unstored target and those duplicating extracted links; publishes rows with the content-hash and generation guard ('superseded' on a full index); prunes rows of removed documents and vanished endpoints without a model call; writes the extraction status; returns a non-outcome result when the provider is unavailable.
acceptanceChecks: Model calls are serial (max concurrency 1)
After one pass, changing one document sends only that document; repo.reindex of an unchanged repository sends none
An unavailable provider writes extraction 'unavailable' with the cause and arms the retry; restoring the provider lets the retry run without a file event
A value with two valid proposals and one with an unknown source publishes the two and counts one; a wrong-shape value leaves the earlier row and retries the document

s10 t7: stale-hash guard and superseded by a full index

s10 t7: proposal validation, resolution and dedupe against extracted links

100 duplicates of extracted links plus 5 wrong proposals measure precision 0/5 and the switch reads off
